test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: On November 26, 1949, Dr. Rajendra Prasad signed the document as president of the assembly. Which document is being referred to here?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Constitution of India.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The document referred to in the question is the Constitution of India.**
 
• **Dr. Rajendra Prasad **signed the Constitution of India as th**e first President of India on November 26, 1949.**
 
• The Constitution of India is the supreme law of India and provides the framework for governance and fundamental rights of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India was drafted by the Constituent Assembly, formed in 1946 and included representatives from all parts of India.
 
• The Constitution of India came into effect on **January 26, 1950, which is celebrated as Republic Day in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Option 1: **The Instrument of Accession refers** to the legal document signed by the rulers of princely states in India to accede to either India or Pakistan after the partition in 1947.
 
• Option **2: The first Constitution draft** was prepared by the drafting committee of the Constituent Assembly in 1947 and underwent several revisions before the final version was signed in 1949.
 
• Option 4: **The Preamble to the Constitution of India is an introductory statement **that outlines the objectives and principles of the Constitution. The Constituent Assembly also adopted it along with the Constitution on November 26, 1949.
